name: palm-wallet
description: Palm Wallet — PROTOTYPE palm-biometric payment system for Egypt. Simulated wallet + simulated biometrics; not production software.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && for d in apps/*/; do [ -f "$d/tsconfig.json" ] && tsc --noEmit -p "$d" || true; done
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,cust,pos -c blue,green,magenta "DATABASE_PATH=$PWD/data/palm-wallet.db npm run dev -w @palmwallet/api" "npm run dev -w @palmwallet/customer" "npm run dev -w @palmwallet/merchant"
